fixture_history: The first final Linux snapshot failed existing HTTPS partial-head case 11 (NeedBody before the expected prefix). Both the prior URL binary and this candidate reproduced with the peer Nagle setting enabled; each passed 12/12 with peer TCP_NODELAY. Only that fixture setting changed before a complete new matrix; 40 ms fallback, 160 ms prefix pause and production sources were unchanged.

A preliminary intentional-shortage fixture supplied a second block before observing the peer checkpoint. The final fixture withholds further producer blocks until 103/final response; product semantics and operation budgets were unchanged.
